Name: Starlets
Author: wrefn
Description:
It should work with old and new saves alike! In 2.0.0, it's recommended that you use [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases]Reset Terrain Features[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destoryable Bushes[/url] in the backwoods on first load.
[b]
How to get Starlet Berries[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Reach 5 hearts with any villager.[/*]
[*]Once you get the mail with the berry, you can buy 1 seed per season.[/*]
[/list]
[b]How to meet the Merchant[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Play at least 3 days and you'll get a letter.[/*]
[*]Her introduction cutscene will play if you enter the correct area when it's raining/snowing.
[spoiler]The correct location is in the tunnel.[/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]Afterwards, you'll be able to trade shop items. There are 2 modded items in her shop: a drying rack from Cornucopia and shrub seeds from Stardew Valley Expanded. Her stock changes by season and for each even and odd day.[/*]
[/list][b]
Berry Usage
[/b]Starlet Berries take 20 days to grow and reproduce every 16 days. They grow in all seasons except winter. Universal Like.
Put 5 in a dehydrator for 3-4 jars of powder. Universal Neutral.
The Starlet Powder can be used to brew Tart Tea in a keg. The tea can be aged in a cask. Universal Like.

To get the cake recipe, complete a quest that will be given on Summer 7th after meeting the merchant for the first time.

2 of the recipes added in 2.0.0 have variants if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]More Crops[/url] is installed. 
2 recipes and one crop byproduct are loaded if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] is installed.

Mellie loves beets and berries and hates fish and meat. She gives a recipe at 3 hearts and you unlock a seed at 7 hearts. One seed is unlocked after you upgrade your house once & make it through fall y1.

I used [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/]kdau's Scroll Generator[/url]﻿ for the banner and first image!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37727]Terrane [/url]was used for the darker dirt & cliffs in the screenshots.

Let me know of any issues or if things are unbalanced. Creating custom sprites or portraits is encouraged, as long as you [u]do not[/u] use
ai-generated content for it. :)
